title: Manipulated Media via AI Disinformation and Deepfakes in 2024 Elections Erode Trust Across More Than 50 Countries

behaviors.text: AI-driven election disinformation is escalating globally, leveraging easy-to-use generative AI tools to create convincing deepfakes that mislead voters.
This shift has simplified the process for individuals to generate fake content, having already eroded [person] in elections by undermining [person] and manipulating voter perceptions.
Evidence has, for example, been documented in incidents across the U.S., Moldova, Slovakia, Bangladesh, and Taiwan.
